screening_method_note: PASS -- SD29-E5-F2-010 (monster lane), 2026-08-15T02:34:27Z: every field of the 116 records this run wrote (39 monsters + 77 monster abilities) was screened against the bounded, documented term list in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md, zero hits. A hit is a hard stop in this generator, not a warning. Updated by SD31-E6-F10-001 (2026-08-17): the spell lane (`ingest_inner_sea_gods_spells.rs` + `cache_gen::spell_lane_dump` + `enrich_spell_raw_tokens.rs`) added 92 more records (of 96 real base declarations). `isg_spells.lst` declares zero `NAMEISPI:`/`DESCISPI:` tokens at all, so every one of the 4 dropped records (`Abadar's Truthtelling`, `Gozreh's Trident`, `Rovagug's Fury`, `Sympathy (Shelynite)`) was caught by the §52.3 blacklist scan alone -- the §53.5 declared-PI reader ran on every record and found nothing to read, not a second independent catch (corrected 2026-08-17, SD31-W9-INTEGRATE-001: the prior wording, "each caught independently by both screens," was false for a book with no declared-PI tokens). Both SD-30 PI contracts are still applied per record to NAME, DESCRIPTION and every `raw_tokens` field independently (not only NAME/DESCRIPTION -- a real `FACTSET:Deity|<name>` token redacts even when the description itself is clean). records_processed is now 208 (116 + 92): the real on-disk count for this book across every kind any lane has ingested (`find data/corpus/inner_sea_gods -name '*.json' ! -name LICENSE.json | wc -l`). records_redacted is 5 (corrected 2026-08-17, SD31-W9-INTEGRATE-001, was 4): every shipped spell record whose DESCRIPTION itself was redacted for a blacklist hit (`license == "PI-REDACTED"`), re-derived directly from the shipped records after fixing a real PI exposure this integration cycle found and closed -- `isg_spells.lst:46`'s `FACTSET:Deity|Cayden CaiLean` (the oracle's own miscapitalized spelling) and `isg_spells.lst:8`'s DESC use of "lrori" (the oracle's own OCR of "Irori") both survived the exact-substring blacklist scan unredacted because neither term's exact-cased/exact-spelled form was on the list; both are now covered (`pi_screening::PI_BLACKLIST_TERMS`) and re-screened clean on disk. This is separate from, and undercounts, the 51 further shipped records carrying a redacted non-DESCRIPTION `raw_tokens` field (mostly `FACTSET`) whose top-level `license` correctly stays `OGL` because their DESCRIPTION field itself is clean -- `records_redacted` tracks description-level redactions only, matching its own field name; the token-level population is not separately fielded here. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring scan and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see.
